zh: 把等式两边移项：a[i]−b[j]=a[j]−b[i] 等价于 a[i]+b[i]=a[j]+b[j]，于是每个下标只需要一个值 c[i]=a[i]+b[i]。
问题变成统计 i≤j 且 c[i]=c[j] 的下标对，i=j 时等式恒成立也要计入。从左到右扫描，用哈希表记录每个值已经出现的次数即可。
扫描到 j 时先把 cnt[c[j]] 加一，再把加一后的值累加进答案（它正好是以 j 为右端、包括 j 自己在内的配对数）。c[i] 可达 ±2×10⁹，答案可达约 2×10¹⁰，都要用 64 位整数。
en: Rearrange the equation: a[i] - b[j] = a[j] - b[i] is equivalent to a[i] + b[i] = a[j] + b[j], so each index only needs the single value c[i] = a[i] + b[i].

The task becomes counting index pairs with i <= j and c[i] = c[j]; the pair i = j always satisfies the equation and must be counted. Scan from left to right and keep, in a hash map, how many times each value has appeared.

At index j, first increment cnt[c[j]], then add the incremented value to the answer; it is exactly the number of pairs ending at j, including j itself. c[i] can reach +-2 * 10^9 and the answer about 2 * 10^10, so use 64-bit integers for both.

explanationEn:
## Problem

Given two arrays a and b of equal length, count the index pairs (i, j) with i <= j and a[i] - b[j] = a[j] - b[i].

## Approach

Rearrange: a[i] - b[j] = a[j] - b[i] <=> a[i] + b[i] = a[j] + b[j]. Let c[i] = a[i] + b[i]; the problem becomes counting pairs with i <= j and c[i] = c[j] (i = j always qualifies). Scan from left to right with a hash map storing how many times each value has appeared; at index i, increment that value's count and add the whole count to the answer (including i itself).

## Correctness

The rearrangement is reversible; every qualifying (i, j) is counted exactly once, when the scan reaches j.

## Complexity

O(n) expected. c[i] can reach +-2 * 10^9 and the answer about 2 * 10^10, so both need 64-bit integers.

## Independent verification

The oracle compares every pair i <= j directly with the original equation (O(n^2), small data only), without rearranging. Expected values of the large cases were computed with a Counter as sum of cnt * (cnt + 1) / 2. All array pairs of length 1..4 with elements -1..1 were enumerated and the reference program was actually run on each. The wrong solutions cover missing i = j, grouping by a - b by mistake, 32-bit counters and counting ordered pairs.
